dct_description_sm: Bowhead whales were photographed in Igloolik (2007-2009) and Repulse Bay (2008-2009) using digital SLR cameras to identify individual animals based on scars and pigmentation patterns. Data collection focused on adult females with calves (cow-calf pairs) to determine calving intervals and population growth potential. However, all encountered whales were photographed for inclusion in the database, and the data can also be used for capture-mark-recapture estimates of population size.
dct_title_s: Photo-identification of bowhead whales (Balaena mysticetus) - Foxe Basin and Hudson Bay
